item.title: Trump plans to lower tariffs on Indian goods to 18% after India agreed to stop buying Russian oil
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — President Donald Trump said Monday that he plans to lower tariffs on goods from India to 18%, from 25% , after Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi agreed to stop buying Russian oil .

item.title: Fire chief says cause of fire that sank three yachts will likely never be found
item.description: VICTORIA — A marina fire in Sidney, B.C. has sunk three yachts worth millions, and the community's fire chief says investigators may never find the cause.

item.title: Judge blocks Trump administration from ending protections for Haitians
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Ohio (AP) — A federal judge on Monday blocked the end of protections that have allowed roughly 350,000 Haitians to live in the U.S., dealing President Donald Trump's immigration agenda another legal, though perhaps temporary, setback.

item.title: Rizqy says partisan use of legislature funds led to chief of staff firing
item.description: QUÉBEC — Marwah Rizqy is breaking her silence about what prompted her to fire her chief of staff, leading to her expulsion from the Quebec Liberal party caucus last year.

item.title: 'It's our livelihood': Rural Ontario town worries as Ottawa plans military radar site
item.description: The first sign that something was afoot in the rural Ontario community of Clearview came about a year ago, when Mayor Doug Measures found out that a local farm was registered to the Crown months after it was listed for sale.

item.title: 'Grieving together': 3 players on Alberta junior hockey team dead in vehicle crash
item.description: STAVELY — Three players on an Alberta junior hockey team killed in a crash while heading to practice are being remembered as exceptional young men who had a spark in their eyes for the sport.

item.title: B.C. man feared a 'hit' on him before he and family found dead, inquest hears
item.description: A Mountie testifying at an inquest into the 2023 deaths of a couple and their two children in Prince Rupert, B.C.
